title: Advanced Photovoltaic Module Characterization: Using Image Transformers for Current-Voltage Curve Prediction From Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: Swin transformer regresses the full I-V curve from module EL; single-diode parameters are then extracted from the predicted curve.
adaptation: Use as the reference for the Sandia PV-IV-EL set (438 modules, 613 EL + flash I-V pairs, CC BY 4.0, OpenEI 8378) as a second external power check for our predicted inactive fraction. Not a method for our masks.
min_experiment: Same as the ELPVPOWER check, on Sandia PV-IV-EL. Kill if Spearman < 0.3 for every model.
evidence: R: MPP, Isc and Voc mean error < 1%; Rs error 5.19%; Rsh and I0 worse.
